text: Agello's model catalog at commit 93122b6 lists two downloads, gemma-4-E4B-it-fp16-rope.litertlm of 3,660,726,272 bytes and embeddinggemma-2-text-270m.litertlm of 164,626,432 bytes, which together take 3,825,352,704 bytes (3.83 GB, 3.56 GiB) of storage, not counting engine caches.

Agello's DeviceProfile.keepsConversationAcrossHelpers (commit 93122b6), on a runtime that keeps sessions and with a non-zero available-memory reading, keeps the chat's conversation across a helper only when available memory is at least 28,672 x maxNumTokens + 400,000,000 bytes: 634,881,024 bytes at 8,192 tokens, 869,762,048 at 16,384 and 1,339,524,096 at 32,768.
